Awards & Achievements

Landmark North clinches Gold Award in "Hong Kong Smoke-free Leading Company Awards 2023"

Kai Shing Property Management Services Limited (Kai Shing) has been actively creating a better living environment for its customers, while also placing great importance on employees' physical and mental well-being by creating a healthy and safe working environment. Recently, Landmark North, a shopping mall managed by Kai Shing has won the Gold Award at the "Hong Kong Smoke-free Leading Company Awards 2023" organised by the Hong Kong Council on Smoking and Health (COSH). This recognition acknowledges the property's continuous efforts in promoting a smoke-free culture and establishing a healthy workplace, it brings a great encouragement to the team! Additionally, four properties under Kai Shing's management, including New Town Plaza, C-Bons International Center, Lai Yan Court and Lei On Court, were also recognised by the judges and received Certificates of Merit at the ceremony, commending their contribution in promoting a smoke-free culture.

Over the years, Kai Shing's management team has spared no effort in promoting a smoke-free culture in properties, in which Landmark North is a pioneer. Since 2010, the Gold Awardee, Landmark North has started to ban smoking at all indoor workplace. In recent years, the property's management team has made significant efforts to promote a smoke-free culture among employees and the public. For instance, designating more areas as the smoke-free zones with infrared smoking sensor and smoke-free broadcasts installed; appointing some frontline colleagues as "Smoke-Free Ambassadors" for patrolling within the property and promoting the smoke-free culture to colleagues, tenants and customers. Besides, the management team has also designed a "Smoke-Free Elf" signage, displaying in public areas and distributing to tenants and restaurants to call for more support. The management team has also set up a "Smile and Wellness Room" equipped with recreational facilities, to encourage employees to develop other interests to replace smoking habit during break times. The room is also displaying 3D models of body's organs with harmful effects of smoking and providing free "nicotine gum" to get rid of smoking for those colleagues in need. After more than fourteen years of collaborative efforts, the proportion of smoking employees at Landmark North has successfully decreased significantly from 20% in 2010 to 8% last year, the team is looking forward to further reducing the proportion to 5% or below in the future.

Kai Shing is honoured to receive this award in recognition of the team's efforts in promoting a smoke-free culture. We will continue to take the social responsibility to promote a smoke-free culture with stakeholders, for reducing the smoking population and creating a healthy and pleasant working and living environment, and together building a smoke-free Hong Kong.

The awarded properties of "Hong Kong Smoke-free Leading Company Awards 2023" are listed as follows:

Category Properties
Gold Landmark North
Merit New Town Plaza
Merit C-Bons International Center
Merit Lai Yan Court
Merit Lei On Court
